messages:
marta: heads up — noticed a big mismatch between the billing dashboard and invoices for customer acme-inc. dashboard shows ~2.1M tokens on 2025-03-04, invoice shows ~1.4M. tagging oncall @kai — could be the metering ingestion lag/backfill we saw last month
prod_oncall_bot: ALERT: metering-ingest-lag >= 10m for service:redwood-metering (summary: consumer lag on topic metering.events)
kai: looking. any recent deploys to the metering producer or ingestion workers in the last 24h? also need logs from the replay/backfill run if someone triggered it.
support_rod: acme reported an unexpected overage on the invoice, they escalated to support at 07:12 UTC. invoice: https://billing.redwood.example/acme-inc/invoice/2025-03 (redacted)
ben: saw a backlog on the kafka topic overnight — consumer group "metering-ingest-cg" had partition lag ~1.2M messages. suspect the ingester fell behind because a consumer instance restarted and missed offsets. quick check output:
```
# kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --group metering-ingest-cg --describe
TOPIC            PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
metering.events  0          421234          1623456         1202122
metering.events  1          520134          1623000         1102866
```
ben: replay tool was kicked off automatically by the orchestrator at 02:00 UTC but it errored when dedupe validation hit duplicate keys. exception snippet:
```
ERROR replay.worker - DuplicateKeyException: unique_event_key already exists: customer_id=acme-inc, seq=98765
Stack: replay/worker.go:214
```
agnes: duplicate key error means dedupe/indexing invariants failed, probably because some events arrived with missing event_id or malformed metadata. that would cause replay to abort so events never reached billing DB. we should verify producer contract.
kai: I checked the commit history — on 2025-03-03 a small change to the producer serialization removed event_id when payload size > 8KB (regression). PR: https://git.redwood/commits/ser/4352. re-opened a hotfix PR.
marta: ok, breakdown of what to do: 1) patch producer (done) 2) re-run replay with dedupe transform that tolerates missing event_id by deriving id from (customer_id, timestamp, seq) 3) run checksum reconciliation against invoices and dashboard counts. assigning owners below.
ben: replay command I used (safe mode):
```
replay-tool --topic metering.events --from-offset 120000 --to-offset 1623456 \ 
  --transform dedupe --dedupe-key "customer_id|timestamp|seq" \ 
  --checkpoint /checkpoints/replay-acme-20250304 --output s3://replay-outputs/acme/2025-03-04/
```
ben: note — had to enable idempotent writes to billing DB and use upsert to avoid DuplicateKeyException. also added a transient delay to avoid DB hotspotting.
support_rod: ETA for backfill to finish? acme wants a timeline to know if we should issue a provisional credit.
marta: replay started 02:30 UTC after the workaround. current progress: ~45% processed according to replay-tool. estimated time remaining ~3.5h. dashboard for progress: https://dash.redwood.example/replays/acme-20250304 (internal) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
agnes: finance note — we can provisionally credit the customer for the delta once replay completes and counts reconcile. we should not issue a final credit until checksum job passes.
ben: a few gotchas found: 1) S3 replay segments had duplicate batches due to a previous partial retry, I added dedupe-by-checksum step when building the replay bundle. 2) there was an offset checkpoint skew (consumer committed out-of-order offsets for partition 2), fixed by resetting offset to earliest safe point.
kai: updating the incident runbook: add a new step to validate producer event_id presence and add automatic derivation fallback. created PR to runbook: https://docs.redwood/ops/replay-runbook#derive-event-id-fallback
marta: owners & action items:
- ben: finish replay and confirm 100% processed, post final replay-tool summary (ETA 4h)
- agnes: prepare provisional credit calculation and email draft to acme (hold until reconciliation)
- kai: merge producer hotfix and monitor prod ingestion for next 24h
- support_rod: keep customer updated every 2h, escalate to finance if needed
I'll follow up in 1h with progress.
prod_oncall_bot: NOTE: replay job completed at 06:12 UTC. exit code 0. processed=1,843,222 deduped=4,132 failed=0
ben: replay-tool summary attached in logs bucket s3://replay-outputs/acme/2025-03-04/summary.json. post-replay, I kicked off the billing ingest job and the reconciliation checksum job. initial checksum diff shows dashboard vs billing DB delta now ~+1,120 tokens (within tolerance), full invoice recalculation queued.
agnes: finance will hold provisional credit pending final invoice regen. if final invoice still shows >1% variance, we'll apply targeted credit and notify customer.
marta: thanks team. closing this thread once finance confirms invoice regen and customer update sent. :thumbsup:
